import json
import math
import os
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import receipt,file_sha256

selection_path=Path('results/training/qwen38_selection.json')
selection=json.loads(selection_path.read_text())
assert selection['status']=='frozen' and selection['eval_batch_size']==4 and selection['final_candidate_family']==11
assert selection['test_root']==f"results/final/qwen38-selected/{selection['label']}/results"
assert file_sha256(selection['adapter_file'])==selection['adapter_sha256']
path=Path('results/training/qwen38_selected_test_plan.json');assert not path.exists()
env={**os.environ,'KAGGLE_CONFIG_DIR':str(Path('runs/kaggle_oauth_config').resolve())}
for name in ('KAGGLE_KEY','KAGGLE_API_TOKEN','KAGGLE_TOKEN_FILE'):env.pop(name,None)
subprocess.run(['/Users/nico/.local/share/uv/tools/kaggle/bin/python','scripts/kaggle_quota.py'],env=env,check=True)
snapshot=json.loads(Path('results/training/kaggle_account_budget_snapshot.json').read_text());quota=snapshot['quota']
available=quota['gpu_seconds_total']-quota['gpu_seconds_used']-quota['gpu_seconds_reserved']
other=json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen38_primary_grpo_validation.json').read_text())
remaining_other=max(0,other['session_timeout_seconds']-(datetime.now(timezone.utc)-datetime.fromisoformat(other['submitted_at'])).total_seconds()) if other['status']=='submitted' else 0
session_cap=min(43200,math.floor((available-remaining_other-300)/60)*60)
assert session_cap>=15900,'Keep the originally reserved complete-test budget; inspect insufficient quota before submitting'
script_cap=session_cap-300
folder=Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_selected_test')
command=['.venv/bin/python','train/build_kaggle_kernel.py','--qwen38-evaluate','--evaluation-split','test',
    '--evaluate-adapter',selection['method'],'--newest-batch-size','4','--evaluation-budget-seconds',str(script_cap),'--out',str(folder)]
subprocess.run(command,check=True)
p=folder/'kernel-metadata.json';meta=json.loads(p.read_text());meta.update(id='nicolascoquelet/makemarketbench-qwen38-batch4-test',title='MakeMarketBench Qwen38 batch4 test');assert meta['is_private'] and len(meta['title'])<=50;p.write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n')
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'acquire the one already frozen newest-family test candidate; allocate quota using costs only'},selection['provenance']['model_revision']),
    'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'status':'registered_before_test','selection_file':str(selection_path),'selection_sha256':file_sha256(selection_path),
    'command':command,'metadata':meta,'source_sha256':file_sha256(folder/meta['code_file']),'quota_snapshot':snapshot,
    'available_seconds':available,'remaining_native_grpo_cap_seconds':remaining_other,'session_timeout_seconds':session_cap,'script_cap_seconds':script_cap,
    'budget_rule':'Session cap = min(43200, floor-to-minute(official available seconds - remaining running native GRPO session cap - 300)). Script cap is session cap minus 300. Require at least the originally reserved 15900-second session. No outcome-dependent budget choice.',
    'test_seeds':[200,399],'episodes_per_game':200,'batch_size':4,'label':selection['label'],
    'canonical_test_root':selection['test_root'],'acquisition':'One fixed policy; preserve completed groups and exact prompt responses across any missing-only resume. No new training or policy selection uses test outcomes.'}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Prepared selected test',selection['label'],'session cap',session_cap,flush=True)
selection_rule: Use only the primary seed-zero batch-four SFT/GRPO winner frozen by max min(dice percent -80, cards percent), SFT ties; require complete 100/game validation for both.
session_budget_rule: min(43200, floor-to-minute(official available GPU seconds - remaining running native GRPO cap - 300)); require >=15900 seconds, with script cap 300 seconds shorter. No score enters budget allocation.
retention: Download every saved version unchanged. If a cap requires missing-only resume, preserve original seed groups and greedy response cache; publish the complete canonical raw cohort by verified copy into the frozen path. Partial cohorts remain unscored.
